observations.content: User asked (in Vietnamese) to plan testing all tools/skills/extensions in the workspace and report results.

Assistant surveyed workspace: .pi/skills contains analyze-sessions, pdf-reader, teach, visualize, youtube-transcript, disabled-pi-scripts; .pi/extensions contains snip, web-fetch, ask-user-question.ts, subagent-types, observational-memory, visual-tools, quiz.ts, md-log.ts.
Project root extensions/ dev copies: ask-user-question, observational-memory, quiz, snip, subagent-types (must sync to .pi/extensions manually).
Read HANDOFF-observational-memory.md: workspace learn ported amosblomqvist repos (pi-config, learn, pi-subagents) to Paseo; observational-memory is the last item to decide/install.

Handoff states environment: Paseo daemon 0.6.1 must NOT be restarted by assistant (kills running session agent, reminder 3x); pi 0.84.4 at /home/coder/.npm-global/lib/node_modules/@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent/; test runner bun test, typecheck bunx tsc --noEmit; Pi RPC smoke via spawning 'pi --mode rpc' + stdin JSONL (see extensions/ask-user-question/smoke-rpc.ts).

Handoff lists 10 port conventions applied to all extensions: keep original logic, UI-layer RPC-safe only, use pi.sendMessage for in-turn feedback (notify is dropped mid-turn), no side-channel file reads, descriptions without explanation, extension fills all payload fields, agent only sends, pin live tool names (re-register from SDK factory for read/bash/edit/write), required test workflow unit->RPC smoke->E2E via paseo agent run, kill old pi process before testing new ext.

Handoff lists known Paseo bugs: notify() dropped mid-turn; getInputQuestionTitle placeholder with optional/skip overrides title to 'Optional response'; multiSelect hardcoded false; pi provider lacks steerActiveTurn so steering interrupts+replaces; JSONL_RPC_DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS 30s; daemon restart leaves agent stuck on 'Pi RPC process is closed'.

Handoff recommendation: install observational-memory near-original, only replacing /om:status output with sendMessage, widget gauges into one timeline message, cost footer merged; map observer model to glm-5.3-flash and consolidator to glm-5.3.
settings.json observational-memory namespace: observer provider cli-openai id fci/deepseek-v4-flash thinking medium; consolidator provider cli-openai id mmcp/MiniMax-M3 thinking high; passive false.
Working range confirmed ask_user_question works: question with options displayed, chosen 'Hoạt động tốt', supports free-form, single-choice, and multiSelect.

Prior session (before OM install) tested 12/12 extensions+skills all PASS: ask-user-question 5/5 modes, quiz 10/10, md-log 34KB backfill, snip 25/25 unit + v2 guided flow, visual-tools 6/6 render, web-fetch, subagent-types 27/27 + 4 real subagents.

Prior session notes web-debug skill removed by user; web_search/source_check functional with provider duckduckgo (Exa free quota exhausted), fetch_content readable/answer needs extraction key; emoji font missing (fonts-noto-color-emoji).

MCP paseo was initially disconnected (0/1 servers); assistant then reconnected it successfully, exposing 39 tools (create_agent, send_agent_prompt, schedules, heartbeats, terminals, workspaces, providers, models, profiles, permissions, agent activity/mode).

om_status returned clean output: observers in flight 0/4, active observations 0, next observer 7,287/10,000 tok, pool 0 tok (target 10,000, consolidate at 15,000), consolidator idle, 0 topic files, no journey, session cost $0.0000, pipeline alive and ready to observe.

Assistant devised plan: test MCP paseo reconnect, observational-memory (new), smoke re-verify previously-passed extensions/skills, then built-in file/web/visual/spawn tools, then interactive quiz+ask_user_question last.

Batch 1 file tools completed working: write created /tmp/pi-tool-test/sample.md (66 bytes), read returned content, edit replaced 1 block, find returned sample.md, grep matched 'Line A: EDITED by edit tool', bash and safe_bash both returned OK.
False alarm during file test: write reported success but a parallel bash ls could not find /tmp/pi-tool-test; resolved as a race condition between parallel calls, file existed (66 bytes).
